name: SBB
author: vvkycodevv
description: Next Swiss train in the Omarchy bar, a live departure board, and route search. Data from transport.opendata.ch.

barWidget.description: Next departure from your home station, with a departures board and route search in the panel.

schema.label: Home station
schema.description: Station shown on the departure board and followed by the bar.

schema.label: Only trains towards
schema.description: Optional. The bar shows the next train that stops here, e.g. Luzern.

schema.label: Show in bar
schema.description: Next departure from the home station in the bar. Off: only the train icon.

schema.label: Colours
schema.description: Figma: the Tokyo Night pill and panel from the design. Theme: follow the active Omarchy theme.

schema.label: Route search results
schema.description: Connections listed per route search, including favourite routes.

schema.label: Notify when late by (minutes)
schema.description: 0 turns notifications off. Cancellations are always reported when this is on.

schema.label: Favourite routes
schema.description: From > To, separated by semicolons, e.g. Bern > Thun. Numbered 1 to 9: ctrl 1-9 in the route search, super+alt+1-9 with the bindings from the README. Add the current route with ctrl s.
